Implemented in 5f58cfc. Evidence carries the instant it witnessed; Claim::derive folds the observation from whichever evidence set the presence level; attested_at and present_until derive from that rather than from the request clock; persona_max_age is un-refused and enforced, folded with min across audiences. Wall clock, since the value is published. age_at returns None for a future observation. Honest limit recorded in the commit: for evidence any attestor can produce today the published integer is unchanged, because nothing caches evidence across requests — what changed is that the clock read now sits where evidence can override it, and tier() is exhaustive so a new variant must decide what instant it witnesses.
